intro: Second Chronicles continues the story, from King Solomon to the fall of Jerusalem, told through the kings of Judah.

Chapters one to nine: Solomon builds the temple, and God's glory fills it. Chapters ten to thirty-six: the kings of Judah, some who sought God and some who turned away, until Babylon destroys Jerusalem.
It ends with a door opening: King Cyrus of Persia lets the people go home.
Tradition holds that Ezra wrote it.
Listen for the promise in chapter seven: if my people shall humble themselves, and pray, then will I hear from heaven.
